title: BABYDOLL
lyrics:
[00:02.37]Call me Babydoll
[00:07.71]Darling, I'm fallin'
[00:10.45]Fucked up over you
[00:13.31]Bite me, bruise me
[00:16.12]Leave me like you do
[00:18.99]Darling, I'm callin'
[00:21.71]Lay me in my tomb
[00:25.57]In my tomb
[00:27.75]Call me Babydoll
[00:30.59]Come break down these walls
[00:33.40]Don't leave me alone
[00:39.12]Call me Babydoll
[00:41.82]Too cold, it's withdrawal
[00:44.72]This house ain't a home
[00:52.44]Oh, Father, forgive me
[00:55.56]For all my sins
[00:58.58]When I meet your eyes
[01:01.30]The devil, he wins
[01:04.14]Blinded by your lies
[01:06.95]But I play pretend
[01:10.83]Play pretend
[01:12.97]Call me Babydoll
[01:15.76]Come break down these walls
[01:18.59]Don't leave me alone
[01:24.24]Call me Babydoll
[01:27.01]Too cold, it's withdrawal
[01:29.84]This house ain't a home
[01:43.98]Call me Babydoll
[01:55.30]Call me Babydoll
[01:58.02]Wrapped around your finger
[02:01.02]Wish your tongue would linger
[02:04.13]I need your warmth just to stay high
[02:09.38]Now, you're holding me down
[02:12.22]I scream but make no sound
[02:15.37]Nothing to hold, my hands are tied
[02:20.68]Call me Babydoll
[02:23.54]Come break down these walls
[02:26.35]Don't leave me alone
[02:31.97]Call me Babydoll
[02:34.76]Too cold, it's withdrawal
[02:37.62]This house ain't a home
[02:51.74]Call me Babydoll
[03:03.02]Call me Babydoll
